title: The Ass and His Purchaser
text:
A man who wanted to buy a donkey went to the market and found one he liked. Before paying, he asked the seller whether he could take the animal home for a short trial, and the seller agreed.

At home the man led the new donkey into his yard, where his own donkeys were standing, and let it go to see what it would do. The newcomer looked around at all of them. Then it walked past the strong, steady workers and went to stand right beside the laziest and greediest donkey in the yard, the one that did the least work and ate the most.

The man did not wait to see any more. He put a halter on the donkey, led it straight back to the market and handed it to the seller.

The seller was surprised. "Surely you have not tested him properly in so short a time," he said. "I do not need any more of a test," replied the man. "I can see what sort of animal he is from the companion he chose for himself."
lesson: The people you choose to spend your time with shape you and tell others who you are. Choose companions you would be glad to resemble.
